S-00.name: Rust bucket
S-00.decidedBy: Kyle, 17 Nov 2026: the starter is the Rust bucket, her own model. In both games since 18 Nov 2026 (Runners PR #75; Lite has the same model). Kyle, 25 Nov 2026: give her her own card, since every player starts in her.
S-00.quote: The boat every player starts in: a Scrapper that was due for the scrapyard. Booker gives the Runner a boat nobody wanted.
S-00.look: The Scrapper run down: bent rails, the wheelhouse roof rusted through, the windows boarded up, and rust streaks and patched plating from bow to stern.
works: Starter: every player begins in her, free. Every first ship of the other lines is traded up from her.
Refit: at ARI's yard she can be traded in and rebuilt as a clean Scrapper for 500 CR.
Cargo: 3 pallets on deck. A crane at the berth lifts cargo on and off from above; nothing rolls on.
Scrap: her deck crane swings its magnet out over the side, lifts scrap from the water and drops it in the open bin on deck. Holds 8 units.
Loot: sunk pirates leave pallets floating, each with a random load. Her magnet crane lifts a pallet aboard onto one of her 3 pallet places, so a full deck takes no more.
Towing: none. She has no winch.
Fighting: 1 weapon mount (1 small). The player buys and fits the guns; each one trains and fires on its own pad.
Handling: 45 m/s top speed, 90 hull points. Her plating is rotten through in places, so she is a little slower and weaker than a clean Scrapper (48 m/s, 100).
S-00.atlas: Starter: the player's Scrapper is the **Rust bucket**, her own model: the approved Scrapper made into a boat that was due for the scrapyard: bent rails, roof rusted through, windows boarded up. Booker gives the Runner a boat nobody wanted. The clean Scrapper is the one you can buy. Because she's in bad shape the Rust bucket is slightly slower and weaker: 45 m/s and 90 hull points (clean Scrapper 48 m/s, 100).

S-01.quote: The clean Scrapper: the starter Rust bucket rebuilt at ARI's yard. Picks up loose scrap and carries a few pallets. Cannot tow.
S-01.look: A small harbour workboat: dark hull with a raised bow, tan wheelhouse just forward of midships with a mast, radar and short funnel, a crane on the foredeck, and a long flat after deck with stern rails. The starter, the Rust bucket, is this boat run down and has a page of her own.
works: Refit: players start in the Rust bucket, the same boat run down. At ARI's yard she is traded in and rebuilt as this clean Scrapper for 500 CR, a little faster and tougher. Every ship offered from the Rust bucket is offered from her too.
Cargo: 3 pallets on deck. A crane at the berth lifts cargo on and off from above; nothing rolls on.
Scrap: her deck crane swings its magnet out over the side, lifts scrap from the water and drops it in the open bin on deck. Holds 8 units.
Loot: sunk pirates leave pallets floating, each with a random load. Her magnet crane lifts a pallet aboard onto one of her 3 pallet places, so a full deck takes no more.
Towing: none. She has no winch.
Fighting: 1 weapon mount (1 small). The player buys and fits the guns; each one trains and fires on its own pad.
Handling: 48 m/s top speed, 100 hull points.
